question.instructions: Suggest the support team for this request. Choose manual review when there is insufficient information, more than one team's issue, or no suitable team.

criteria.billing: Charges, invoices, payments, and the status of an already approved refund
criteria.shipping: Delivery, missing parcels, tracking, and arranging a product return
criteria.account: Login, password reset, and account access
criteria.review: Manual review for unclear, unrelated, or multiple-team requests
